messages:
zoe_marketing: Morning! Were polishing the launch narrative and need a reproducible bench package for the marketing repo. Ask: canonical run protocol (step-by-step), smoke rerun on quantized and fp16 variants, deterministic seeds / harness commit, and packaged artifacts (perf + sanitized prompts + short README). Target deadline: EOD Thursday.

arun_runtime: Sounds good. Can you enumerate the exact outputs youll need in the package? That helps us lock CLI and env.

zoe_marketing: Must-haves: 1) perf.jsonl (per-request, include chunk index for streaming), 2) metrics.csv (1s samples), 3) README.txt with exact command(s) + env, 4) sanitized_prompts.json (no PII), 5) small eval/ folder with function-call fidelity results (gold vs model) and pass/fail. Prefer short provenance: harness-version, seed-cohort id, runtime image tag.

arun_runtime: OK. Proposed minimal run protocol: (A) checkout harness v1.4.x and note commit SHA, (B) set seed-cohort=mk-3625, (C) run warmup profile (3 users x 4 short turns) for 120s, (D) run coldstart probe (fresh worker, single 1800-token request), (E) run smoke sweep on targets=[open-3b-quant,open-7b-quant,open-7b-fp16] with concurrency 5. Well attach perf.jsonl with fields: request_id, model, variant, start_ts, end_ts, latency_ms, tokens_in, tokens_out, chunk_index, chunk_latency_ms, gpu_ms. Does that match your needs?

zoe_marketing: Perfect. Also include p50/p75/p90/p95/p99/p999 summaries in CSV and a heatmap image (png) for coldstart vs warm-up percentiles per variant. And include a short note in README on how to reproduce locally (exact redwood-bench flags).

rachel_devops: One infra note: please run on image redwood/runtime:2026-05-11-cuda12.1 to match our deck. Also capture /proc/gpu_info and driver version in README. If you need extra priority for GPU farm we can reserve a slot Thurs AM.

arun_runtime: Good call. Well use that image and include kernel/driver info. For reproducibility were going to stamp artifacts with: provenance: seed-cohort=mk-3625, harness-sha=ab12c4d, run-id=rb-2026-3625009999-A. Well also output a small provenance.txt inside artifacts.

nina_eval: Ill prepare a 30-case fidelity set focusing on function-call schema correctness and argument completeness. Output will be eval/results.csv with columns: prompt_id, expected_schema_ok, model_output_schema_ok, pass_fail, notes. Ill run this after the perf sweep and attach the results. ETA tomorrow noon PT.

zoe_marketing: One additional ask: when you sanitize prompts, replace any real identifiers with synthetic placeholders and include a short mapping doc (not the originals) so we can show sample prompts without exposing data.

arun_runtime: Will sanitize and include sanitized_prompts.json and a synthetic_map.txt describing replacements. For the benchmark harness, we recommend this minimal bundle (well paste harness payload):

rachel_devops: ```json
{  "harness_version":"v1.4",
  "scenario":"repro_demo",
  "users":3,
  "short_turns":4,
  "short_avg_tokens":35,
  "long_probe_tokens":1800,
  "simulate_typing":true,
  "typing_delay_range_ms":[40,120],
  "stream_chunk_ms":150,
  "function_call":true,
  "seed":3625
}
```

arun_runtime: That payload looks good. Example run command to include in README:```bash
redwood-bench --model open-7b-quant --profile repro_demo --harness samples/repro_harness.json --out ./artifacts/rb-2026-3625009999-A --concurrency 5 --seed 3625
```

benchbot: Queued automated run rb-2026-3625009999-A targets=[open-3b-quant,open-7b-quant], profile=repro_demo, expected_duration=20m. Will post artifacts link when complete.

arun_runtime: Plan: smoke on quantized variants tonight (low concurrency), full sweep including fp16 tomorrow morning, then run nina_evals fidelity suite and package artifacts. Well also generate a README snippet with exact env vars: CUDA=12.1, LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/cuda/lib64, REDWOOD_RUNTIME_TAG=2026-05-11-cuda12.1.

zoe_marketing: Awesome. Please tag @zoe_marketing and @nina_eval when artifacts are uploaded. If any variant fails the eval well fallback demo to open-3b-quant and note the tradeoffs in slide copy. Thanks everyone — this reproducibility checklist will be really helpful for press QA. :white_check_mark:
